Language English Degree Bachelor of Engineering, B. Eng.
Next start Summer term 27 Application deadline 03.12.2026
Applicants with an international graduation certificate can apply for our English-taught programs using our very own online portal

The document recognizing your academic qualifications is a mandatory part of your application. To do so, you must apply to Uni Assist for a preliminary review documentation (Vorprüfungsdokumentation - VPD which assesses your eligibility for university admission in Germany).
We can only accept VPDs that are issued for our university, i. e. VPDs from other universities cannot be accepted.
These include your entrance qualification, language certificate(s), the VPD-Certificate from uni-assist, passport picture and a passport copy.
Send us the officially certified documents of your school-leaving certificate or your Bachelor's Degree certificate respectively via postal mail to the address mentioned in the portal.

notes: Le montant des frais de scolarité est de 1 500 EUR par semestre pour les étudiants non-UE, comme indiqué sur la page DAAD et confirmé par la page des frais de candidature. La VPD est obligatoire pour les candidats internationaux, mais c'est la seule exigence de documents spécifiques à ce programme. Les dates limites DATES ne concernent pas spécifiquement les candidats internationaux, mais les pages indiquent que les candidats titulaires d'un diplôme étranger utilisent le portail en ligne de l'université et que la date limite pour le semestre d'été 2027 est le 03.12.2026. La date limite du 30 novembre (DAAD) est antérieure mais n'indique pas d'année, donc non retenue.

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: TOEFL iBT (before 2026): 72 Reading: 18 Listening: 20 Speaking: 17 Writing: 17
In order to study in one of our English-taught degree programs, you need to provide proof of your English language skills at level B2. Please note that the proof must not be older than two years.

note.fr: Fournir le TestAS (module engineering, score ≥ 100), le SAT (≥ 1050) ou l'ACT (≥ 20). Pour le semestre d'été 2027, cette exigence est suspendue.
note.en: Provide TestAS (engineering module, score ≥ 100), SAT (≥ 1050) or ACT (≥ 20). For summer semester 2027, this requirement is suspended.

evidence.quote: In addition to your school-leaving certificate, you will need proof of eligibility to study in Germany for our Bachelor's Degree Programs. This proof can be provided as follows: TestAS (paper-based or digital) core test and subject-specific engineering module with a score of at least 100 SAT with a minimum of 1050 points or ACT with a score of at least 20.
Please note: The aptitude test requirement is being suspended for the application period for summer semester 2027.

note.fr: Votre diplôme de fin d'études secondaires doit être reconnu comme équivalent à une qualification allemande (voir DAAD et anabin).
note.en: Your school-leaving certificate must be recognized as comparable to a German qualification (see DAAD and anabin).

evidence.quote: You can check whether your school-leaving certificate is comparable to a German qualification on both the DAAD (German Academic Exchange Service) and anabin websites.

note.fr: Toute demande doit passer par le VPD (Vorprüfungsdokumentation) obtenu auprès d'uni-assist uniquement pour l'université d'Aalen.
note.en: All applications must go through the VPD (Vorprüfungsdokumentation) obtained from uni-assist, only for Aalen University.
